integrity: The complete table is verified against all normalized sign matrices using perfect-matching and Ryser formulas and independently by a weighted row-multiset sum. The independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite theorem exclusively for the set of 5-by-5 permutation matrices in the additive group M_5(F_2); no extension to other matrix orders is asserted.
The eight-coefficient enumerator is an exhaustive, reproducible integer-arithmetic certificate based on a 65,536-case reduction and a weighted 3,876-case independent orbit enumeration.

The closest older signed-permanent paper was published in print in 2005, but an exact day of initial public distribution was not independently verified; the recorded date is the day-verified initial arXiv submission of the motivating Fourier-algebra reference, not a claim of first chronological publication of every reference.
Published table historical priority remains non-exhaustive, and independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Exact order-five binary permutation Fourier spectrum and endpoint norm
